lines.en: Hi Omar! The weather is nice and cool today.
Hi Sara! Yes, I love it. It was very hot in Cairo last week.
I know. The temperature reached forty degrees.
Spring is the best season of the year.
I agree. But I love winter because I hate the heat.
Take an umbrella, it might rain tomorrow.
Thanks. The traffic was terrible this morning.
I live in a busy street near the city center.
There is a new metro station near my house.
Great! I took a taxi because the bus was late.
The streets are always crowded on weekends.
I want to live in a calmer place one day.
Me too. My neighborhood is quiet and safe at night.
Are you hungry? Do you prefer tea or coffee after dinner?
Tea, please. I cooked dinner for my family yesterday.
Nice! What did you cook?
We ate grilled chicken and rice. This dish needs more salt and pepper.
My mother makes the best stuffed vegetables.
Cooking at home is cheaper than eating out.
True. This restaurant is too expensive for me.
I am saving money to buy a new phone.
Can you lend me fifty pounds until tomorrow?
Again? You spent all your salary in the first week!
I know. I need to open a bank account and save more.
The bank is closed on Fridays. I want to withdraw some cash from the ATM.
Can I pay by card, or cash only at the bakery?
Card is fine. I bought fresh bread there this morning.
Good. Do you go to the gym, Sara?
I go to the gym three times a week.
I played football with my friends yesterday.
You should stretch before you exercise.
Drink water, because the weather is hot today. I know!
Exercise makes me happy and full of energy.
Okay, I have to go. See you tomorrow!
See you, Omar! Have a nice day.
